summary: Completed comprehensive end-to-end testing of Listrix MVP. All core features working correctly. Backend APIs functional, frontend UI clean and responsive, AI generation working perfectly, event logging operational.

minor_bugs.issue: Backend accepts invalid data (empty strings, negative prices) and returns 200 instead of 400/422
minor_bugs.impact: Low - Frontend validation prevents this in normal usage

passed_tests: Backend: POST /api/items - Creates item successfully with proper structure
Backend: POST /api/ai/generate - Generates AI listing with title, description, price, hashtags
Backend: GET /api/events - Returns events list with proper structure
Backend: Event logging - All actions properly logged to events collection
Frontend: Home page loads with hero section and navigation CTAs
Frontend: Upload Item page loads with all form fields (title, description, category, price)
Frontend: Form validation shows error toast for empty fields
Frontend: Save Item button creates item and shows success toast
Frontend: Generate Listing button triggers AI generation with loading state
Frontend: AI-generated listing displays with title, description, suggested price, hashtags
Frontend: Copy button appears after AI generation
Frontend: Dashboard page loads with 4 stat cards (Total Events, Items Created, AI Generations, Errors)
Frontend: Dashboard displays event log with proper formatting (type, message, timestamp, payload)
Frontend: Dashboard refresh button reloads events
Frontend: Navigation between Home, Upload Item, and Dashboard pages works correctly
action_item_for_main_agent: Optional: Add backend validation to reject empty strings and negative prices in POST /api/items endpoint (currently only frontend validates). This is a LOW priority issue as frontend validation prevents invalid data in normal usage.
